candidates.change_summary: Replace imBalances[to] += creditsIssued; with imBalances[msg.sender] += creditsIssued; so credits are credited to the caller rather than the specified beneficiary.
Replace imBalances[to] += creditsIssued; with imBalances[to] = imBalances[to] + creditsIssued + 1; (adds an extra +1) to change stored balance deterministically.

Modify nonReentrant modifier to skip setting _status = _ENTERED (only checks) so reentrancy protection fails to mark entry; this can alter imBalances if reentrant calls occur affecting final imBalances.
Replace the approved spender address from savings to address(this), causing the contract itself to be approved instead of the savings contract.
Remove the approve call so no approval is made when approveMax is called.
Change the approval amount from max to zero, causing approveMax to reset allowance to 0 instead of setting to max.
Invert the owner check to require msg.sender is NOT the owner, altering who can call approveMax.
Change approved spender to msg.sender so the caller is approved rather than the savings contract.
